notes.title: Discount in the hostel
notes.notes: Hello, the hostel is in discount, if you want to enjoy a game with adult content interactable in first person, now is your chance, there are new guests in the hostel, and added a new studio mode, which will allow you to enjoy the action with the partner you like, both in first person mode, as in the third person mode.

notes.title: New guest in the hostel
notes.notes:
Hello, the first major update to the game is released, which includes the addition of four new characters, and a new game mode called studio mode, for people who are not so interested in the story and want to go straight to the action.

Also changes have been made in the gameplay especially at the start, in previous builds the door of the initial room only opened after looking at the computer, now is open from the start, also when a hidden camera event occurs instead of an icon appears at the top left of the screen, an image of the room where the computer is, this change was made to make the game more intuitive.

Also on the screen to manage the hidden cameras appears a message if movement is detected in the rooms and therefore if you can activate the camera in that room, this is also oriented to make the game more intuitive.

Controls for the gamepad were also added.

Thanks to all who have commented on the forum as in the commentary, thanks to your criticism the game can improve. Thank you very much for your time.
